answer: An agent marketplace requires every seller, including onyx, pearl, and saffron, to lock 100 tokens for 30 days before accepting one job at a time. Extra accounts get no free capacity: each concurrent job requires another independently funded bond. An attacker running 1,000 fake sellers must therefore immobilize 100,000 tokens for a month, bearing financing costs and token-price risk even if every bond is later refunded.
